motion_review: Reviewed the actual GIF frames directly: qa/final-previews/idle.gif (6), running-right.gif (8), running-left.gif (8), waving.gif (4), jumping.gif (5), failed.gif (8), waiting.gif (6), running.gif (6), and review.gif (6), totaling 57 frames. The frame mosaic is qa/final-gif-frames-review.png. All cycles read clearly with stable framing and no conspicuous snap, body rotation, or identity drift. The turquoise aquatic dragon retains its amber-eyed face, branched crest, connected tendrils, oval wing openings, feet and curled tail.

state_reviews.idle: 6 frames: upright idle, blink visible; silhouette and details remain stable.
state_reviews.running-right: 8 frames: faces right throughout with alternating strides; appendages and tail stay in frame.
state_reviews.running-left: 8 actual frames in qa/final-previews/running-left.gif: a separately generated left-facing running cycle (not a mirror). All frames face left; alternating strides read clearly, with the same turquoise dragon identity and tail/wing details retained.
state_reviews.waving: 4 frames: forepaw lifts and returns while body scale and footing stay steady.
state_reviews.jumping: 5 frames: crouch, takeoff, apex, descent, landing; coherent arc with stable character scale.
state_reviews.failed: 8 frames: drooped opening pose progresses into upright recovery; identity and appendages remain intact.
state_reviews.waiting: 6 frames: quiet standing loop with subtle attentive head/gaze movement.
state_reviews.running: 6 frames: compact thinking stance with small body/arm/head adjustments; no locomotion confusion.
state_reviews.review: 6 frames: alert review stance and subtle head/forelimb movement.

look_review: The head and upper neck turn through a coherent clockwise sequence while torso, feet, wings and tail remain planted and consistently oriented. Cardinal up/right/down/left are clear; intermediate poses stay ordered and mostly readable. Crest and whiskers remain connected. The 112.5 down-right pitch is shallow and independently ambiguous on vertical blind review, so it is recorded as a warning.

alpha_review.reason: Inspected the actual-alpha contact sheet: transparent oval openings are consistent with the designed wing apertures; no accidental transparent opening through the torso/body is visible. The isolated lower 315 suspect lies in the leg/foot separation, not a body puncture.

warnings: Direction 112.5 is only shallowly below level and was ambiguous to the blind vertical reviewer; labeled normal-size sequence supports down-right with no wrong quadrant or reversal.
notes: Atlas SHA256 matches the requested final artifact. Existing deterministic chroma and validator PASS are accepted as authoritative; no chroma retry was performed. Cardinal landmark evidence for 090/right and 270/left was checked on enlarged crops from the actual final atlas (qa/cardinal-landmarks-090-270-review.png): muzzle tips extend screen-right and screen-left respectively, while the amber eye confirms each facing direction.
